mails.subject: Hiring across Copenhagen: roles your members may fit
mails.body:
Hi Kanalhuset team,

I hope your weekend is going well. I am writing late because I wanted to get this to you before Monday.

I am a senior recruiter at Crestline Talent, and we are currently building teams for several scale-ups in the Copenhagen area. Many of the people in coworking spaces like yours are exactly the profile our clients look for: independent, technical, used to moving fast.

Open roles this month include:

- Senior backend engineer (Go), hybrid
- Product designer, fully remote within the EU
- Customer success lead, Danish and English
- Finance manager, part-time

We would be very grateful if you could forward this note to your members, or share it on your community board. We also keep a confidential talent pool, and anyone interested can simply send a CV to the address below.

If it is easier, I can send a one-page PDF to print for your noticeboard.

Thank you for your help, and have a lovely Sunday.

Warm regards,
Nadia Okafor
Senior Recruiter, Crestline Talent
https://crestline-talent.example/openroles
mails.justification: A recruitment blast from a staffing firm unknown to the space, asking it to forward job ads to members, with no prior relationship and nothing to answer.

mails.subject: Flere bookinger til jeres mødelokaler?
mails.body:
Hej Kanalhuset,

Skriver kort fra telefonen, så undskyld hvis der er en tastefejl eller to.

Jeg hedder Henrik og arbejder hos Salgsmotor, hvor vi hjælper coworking-miljøer med at få flere henvendelser. Jeg har kigget på jeres hjemmeside og kan se, at I har både mødelokaler og faste pladser, men at bookingformularen er ret gemt væk. Det koster typisk jer en del henvendelser hver måned.

Vi tilbyder en færdig pakke:

- et nyt bookingmodul, der kan sættes op på en dag
- automatiske mails til besøgende, der ikke bookede
- en månedlig rapport over leads

Vi har kørt pakken for flere virksomheder i Norden, og de fleste får en stigning i henvendelser inden for de første uger. Jeg kan sende en gratis analyse af jeres side, hvis I svarer på denne mail, eller vi kan tage en kort snak om 15 minutter. Jeg har tid torsdag eller fredag eftermiddag.

Prisen starter ved 1.900 kr. om måneden, og der er ingen binding de første tre måneder.

Det var det hele. Tak for jeres tid!

Mvh
Henrik Lund
Salgsrådgiver, Salgsmotor
Sendt fra min iPhone
mails.justification: Cold outreach selling a lead-generation package to the space, referencing its website to sound relevant, from a company it never contacted.

mails.subject: Un petit lien pour Kanalhuset ? ☕
mails.body:
Salut l'équipe ! 👋

Je suis tombé sur votre blog Kanalhuset hier, super sympa, surtout la page sur la vie de la communauté. Je gère un site sur le télétravail et j'aimerais vous proposer un échange : j'écris un article invité pour vous, et vous placez un lien vers notre guide du travail à distance. Sinon, on peut aussi vous acheter un lien dans un de vos anciens articles (80 € la mise en place).

Dites-moi si ça vous tente ! ✌️

Jules
mails.justification: A link-exchange and paid backlink proposal from a stranger who flatters the blog without any real relationship.

mails.subject: Staffing partnership for Kanalhuset members
mails.body:
Dear Kanalhuset team,

My name is Isabel Fontaine and I lead the partnerships desk at Harborline Staffing, a Nordic recruitment agency placing temporary and permanent staff across Greater Copenhagen.

We noticed that Kanalhuset hosts a number of growing start-ups, and these companies often struggle with hiring. We would like to offer your community a simple arrangement.

For companies in your space, we can provide:

- Vetted temporary staff (reception, admin, event help) from 285 DKK per hour, billed weekly
- Permanent placements at a fee of 12 percent of the first annual salary, which is below our standard 18 percent
- A free first month of access to our candidate database for every company that mentions your space

In return, we simply ask that you list Harborline as a recommended supplier on your member page, and that you mention our offer in your next member newsletter. We would also be glad to cover the cost of a sandwich lunch for one of your community days, up to 2,000 DKK, so that we can present the service in person.

Our current open vacancies are listed here: https://harborline-staffing.example/vacancies

Please note that our offer is valid until the end of October. I am happy to send our agency profile and references on request.

Best wishes,
Isabel Fontaine
Head of Partnerships, Harborline Staffing
Tel +45 5550 0142
mails.justification: A staffing agency with no prior contact offers a 'partnership' that is just advertising its recruitment fees and job listings to members.

mails.subject: Our chat at the Friday event
mails.body:
Hi,

Sorry to write on a Saturday evening, but I wanted to follow up on our chat at the event last Friday. It was great to see what you are building at Kanalhuset.

I represent the Oakmere Network, and I think there is real potential for cooperation. We connect founders with service providers and would like to explore a co-branded programme with you. I would suggest we speak soon.

I am travelling next week, so perhaps send me a few times that suit you. If you prefer, I can send over our standard partner agreement first.

Best,
Peter Calloway
Oakmere Network
mails.justification: The 'chat at the event' is never specified by name, place or person, and the offer is a vague co-branding idea from an organisation the space does not know.
